newsitem.title: UK: EU seen awarding up to 90,000 T sugar at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU seen awarding up to 90,000 T sugar at tender.

text.p: The European Union (EU) is expected to award up to 90,000 tonnes of current series white sugar at its weekly tender later on Wednesday, traders said.
Estimates for this week's authorised tonnage award ranged from 60,000 to 90,000 tonnes after the EU awarded 45,400 tonnes at its last tender on November 20.
Traders agreed on their forecasts for the maximum restitution for licences at 46.704 Ecus (European currency units) per 100 kg of sugar, based on the Paris March contract.
The EU restitution was 47.002 Ecus last week.
Licences are currently valid until the end of April.
